decisive_items: painless right otorrhea, progressive hearing loss
irregularly enhancing mass in the right ear canal, middle ear cavity, and mastoid air cells
erosive changes of the skull base
response.rationale: R6 is the champion because it has the most comprehensive support from the vignette, including symptoms and imaging findings consistent with cholesteatoma. R4 is the runner-up because it also has significant support, but the combination of otorrhea, hearing loss, and imaging findings is more characteristic of cholesteatoma.

rejected.why: age is not typical for necrotizing otitis externa
systemic vasculitis is less likely without other systemic symptoms
malignant process is possible but less likely without biopsy confirmation
